verdict: Close to the core local-development vision; ready for a controlled pilot, not broad agent-safe completeness.
proven: Reusable bundle files: seed SQL and bundled acme CLI work in both checkouts on Linux and macOS.
Different Postgres and Redis ports/data directories, independently stopped checkouts, real pytest connections.
Linux foreign-server refusal including libpq overrides; macOS poisoned endpoint and required-service refusal.
Explicit conflict rejection; install_failed errors for impossible version and unknown package.
Linux TTL renewal/expiry, active-exec protection, owner death cleanup, zero service leftovers in asserted scenarios.
MCP lifecycle, real fixture tests, structured errors, process timeout and next request.
Local OCI distribution, digest locking after tag moves, explicit update and publication conflict handling.
Generation changes invalidate endpoints; incompatible Redis version fails without losing data; original version recovers.
Git tag moves cannot change a locked bundle even in a fresh empty cache.
remaining: Tool versions are not fully immutable: Python 3.13, Postgres 17, Redis 8 are ranges, uv and jq use latest. Bundle commit/content pins do not freeze all tools.
Custom services get liveness-only checks; Postgres and Redis have instance identity verification.
Lease reclamation requires next gc/up; deleted-project sessions cannot be stopped by Stack.
Native macOS lifecycle smoke passed, but full six-scenario automation still Linux-only; x64 not exercised here.
Cold setup and warm setup are each single observations per platform; no randomized repeated speed study.
Original competitor figures are historical 2026-10-02 observations, not rerun head-to-head. Different setup semantics and resolved versions prohibit claiming speedup ratios.
No real multi-agent task-completion/productivity evaluation, remote/cloud backend or large concurrency stress in this run.
OCI exercised local anonymous registry, not hosted/private credential-helper workflows.

observed_issues.detail: Existing MCP E2E asserted 7 tools while release has 9. First run failed; changed assertion to exact 9 tool names and reran all six successfully.
First attempt bad_pkg/bad_version returned lock_outdated before reaching installs. Added compile and asserted install_failed; final run valid. First attempt retained.

Initial isolated native HOME produced 118-byte Pitchfork socket path, exceeding macOS 104-byte limit. Stack returned structured start_failed. Short isolated /tmp path passed. This is a temporary-state path constraint, not evidence that ordinary project paths fail.

improvement_priorities.action: Resolve and lock exact provider/tool versions, including eliminating latest from examples.
improvement_priorities.acceptance: A clean cache reproduces identical tool/service versions after upstream releases.

improvement_priorities.action: Run the full service/session E2E suite on native macOS in CI and check provider socket path length in doctor.
improvement_priorities.acceptance: Repeat Linux contracts on macOS; diagnose long state paths before downloads/start.

improvement_priorities.action: Add reusable identity probes for custom services.
improvement_priorities.acceptance: A foreign healthy service cannot satisfy an instance check for supported custom bundles.

improvement_priorities.action: Make cleanup independent of project-directory survival and define automatic lease expiry behavior.
improvement_priorities.acceptance: Delete a project or lose the runner and reclaim only its owned services without next project startup.

improvement_priorities.action: Run a real concurrent-agent pilot with measured wrong-instance incidents, orphan rates, task completion and latency distributions.
improvement_priorities.acceptance: Repeated fresh/cached runs and controlled failures across multiple agents and projects.
